android.desc:
Track work hours, active shifts, and 1.5× overtime with ease!
Clock in with one tap, track live work duration and earnings in real time, and estimate exact take-home pay with our built-in Overtime Calculator.
Built for hourly workers, nurses, freelancers, and shift teams.

Support split shifts, multiple jobs, and overnight schedules crossing midnight. Export payroll-ready PDF or Excel timesheets in seconds!

KEY FEATURES:
• Overtime Calculator: Instant "what-if" paycheck estimator with custom multipliers (1.5×, 2.0×) and flat hourly rates
• One-Tap Clock In/Out: Fast, reliable time tracking with real-time duration and break logging
• Automatic Overtime: Auto 1.5× (Time and a half) and double-time calculations
• Overnight Shifts: Flawless past-midnight shift tracking without messy split logs
• Multiple Shifts per Day: Full support for split shifts (e.g. morning & evening)
• Batch Add: Effortlessly log recurring shifts across custom date ranges in seconds
• Flexible Pay Periods: Weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, or custom week starts
• Net & Gross Pay: Accurate calculations with custom hourly rates, breaks, and tax deductions
• Clean Timesheet Export: Share professional PDF reports or Excel/CSV spreadsheets
• 100% Private & Secure: Local-first offline storage—your financial data stays strictly on your device
• Multi-Job & Employee: Manage multiple jobs or track team shifts effortlessly

Stop guessing your paycheck. Download Hours Tracker today and take full control of your hard-earned time!

Privacy Policy  
https://www.hourstracker.top/privacy-policy
